what: float64 Gram matrix K = J J^T of PDE residual gradients over every weight, bias and readout parameter of deep tanh MLPs u(z) = wo . tanh(W_L ... tanh(W_1 z + b_1) ...) + bo, and the damped Gauss-Newton step J^T (K + 1e-3 I)^{-1} r (Levenberg-Marquardt in dual form): gram = (r, K); gn = (0.5 |r|^2, step). Candidate = omnibias.jax.experimental.residual_gram: one reverse pass of sum_b r_b gives the cotangent Q of every pre-activation stream (value, D tangents, Laplacian); dr_b / dW = Q_b P_b^T, so per hidden layer and block pair <dr_b / dW, dr_c / dW> = sum_(t,s) (P_b^T P_c)_ts (Q_b^T Q_c)_ts is formed without the Jacobian when 2.2 pairs (in + out) < in out (pairs = T (T + 1) / 2 within a block, T_a T_b across blocks; T = D + 2 for second-order rows, 1 for boundary values), explicit rows otherwise; first layer and readout explicit; J^T alpha from the same cotangents. Every control forms J: explicitly from the same stream cotangents (strongest at large widths), or per row by vmap of the one-point residual gradient through forward-Laplacian engines, Taylor mode or nested autodiff; every method except the candidate uses the same Cholesky solve. The cell (12, 256) is a control where the rule keeps explicit rows for interior pairs, (16, 768) sits at the rule's crossover, and (2, 1024, B = 2048) is a memory cell where J of the interior rows has 4.3e9 entries. The identity-on-every-layer tier is an ablation of the per-layer rule
hardware: one NVIDIA A100-SXM4-80GB (exclusive), JAX 0.10.2 with jaxlib 0.10.2 CUDA 12 plugins, CPython 3.12

protocol.repetitions: 3 fresh processes (paired by repetition, rotating method order)
protocol.statistic: ratio = strongest-control median / candidate median per tier; lower95 = exp(mean(log r) - 2.920 sd(log r)/sqrt(3)); strongest control = smallest mean log median among qualified tier members
protocol.qualification: every method's gram and gn programs on a reduced instance (width 4, D_q = min(D, 5), B = 4 interior points (+ 1 boundary point), same depth and operator, seed + 1) vs a 50-digit oracle (Taylor series per coordinate direction through the network, J by central differences in every parameter, step by an LU solve in 50 digits): r and K 1e-12 + 1e-10 max |ref|, loss 1e-12 + 1e-10 |ref|, step 1e-12 + 1e-8 max |ref|; the candidate and the independent reproduction pass both under the rule (explicit rows at width 4) and with the identity forced on every hidden layer; full-size outputs finite and digest-checked

status.parity: lower95 < 1 <= ratio or ratio < 1 <= upper bound
status.partial: an applicable tier member failed (e.g. out of memory) or did not qualify; never promoted

protocol.fairness: identical data, initialisation, loss and float64 inputs for every method; compilation excluded (value-and-gradient steady state)

tiers.explicit_jacobian_shared_streams: the full J from the stream cotangents of one reverse pass of sum_b r_b, rg_lib.explicit_J: per layer Q_b P_b^T rows; K = J J^T; step J^T alpha as a product with J
tiers.per_row_forward_laplacian: J = vmap over points of grad of the one-point residual through forward-Laplacian engines: the same stream recursion at one point, omnibias.jax.laplacian.deep_field_value_grad_laplacian and folx.forward_laplacian; K = J J^T
tiers.taylor_mode: J = vmap of grad through jax.experimental.jet, one second-order jet per input direction started at the first pre-activation, gradient from the first coefficients
tiers.nested_autodiff: J = vmap of grad through jax.grad and jax.hessian
tiers.identity_every_layer: ablation: rg_lib with the identity on every hidden layer, no per-layer rule; ghost-norm style

roles.held_out: cells, operators and seed not used for any tuning

full_size_accuracy.what: max over repetitions of per-field relative deviations (norms and sampled entries scaled by the largest sampled reference magnitude) between methods at full size; floor = two controls

cold_cost.what: per cell, medians over repetitions: cold = lowering + compilation ms (excluded from the speed ratios), steady = steady-state median ms, for the candidate and the steady-state-fastest member of every tier; break_even_calls = extra cold ms / steady saving per call (only when the candidate compiles slower and runs faster)
